title: NCCA Nizhny Novgorod, Museum Night
location: National Centre for Contemporary Arts, Nizhny Novgorod
excerpt: Museum Night at the NCCA in Nizhny Novgorod: light-drawing workshops by day, live performances with local musicians, and the facade mapped at night for over 30,000 visitors.
description:
For Museum Night 2019 the whole LiGHT-UP team of that moment travelled to Nizhny Novgorod, Russia: Tim Walther, Lisa, Jan Willem Campmans and me.
We began with a light-drawing workshop for children, drawing with light on PlayStation uDraw tablets running Happytron, LiGHT-UP's own application for drawing with projected light.
Then came the performances. I played live first indoors, together with local musicians from Nizhny, and at night we moved the projectors outside and mapped the facade of the museum for more than 30,000 visitors.
The content was everything I had brought with me, pre-rendered, mixed with 3D animations of the building that we modelled on the spot in Cinema 4D and ran through Resolume effects.
> Working on an unfamiliar building in an unfamiliar city meant reading the architecture from scratch, in a few days, and finding what the facade wanted to do with light before the night began.
credits: LiGHT-UP Collective: Tim Walther, Lisa, Jan Willem Campmans and Jaco Schilp. Light-drawing workshops on PlayStation uDraw tablets running Happytron, LiGHT-UP's light-drawing application, conceived by Jan Willem Campmans and developed with Tim Walther. Building animations in Cinema 4D, played live in Resolume. Live performance with musicians from Nizhny Novgorod. Hosted by the NCCA, Nizhny Novgorod, Museum Night 2019. With thanks to Anna Gorokhovskaya, Aeger Smoothie, Anna Gor, Anna Kostyan, Xenia Anoufrieva, technician Alexander, and the amazing help of Polina Ashina.
